# Task

`from xurrent import Task` · module `xurrent.tasks` · API resource `/tasks` · [Xurrent API docs](https://developer.xurrent.com/v1/tasks/)

## Enums

### TaskPredefinedFilter

Used by: `Task.get_tasks`

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `finished` | List all finished tasks |
| `open` | List all open tasks |
| `managed_by_me` | List all tasks that are part of a workflow which manager is the API user |
| `assigned_to_my_team` | List all tasks that are assigned to one of the teams that the API user is a member of |
| `assigned_to_me` | List all tasks that are assigned to the API user |
| `approval_by_me` | List all approval tasks that are assigned to the API user and which status is different from ‘Registered’ |
